policy: Photographer/creator and depicted person are separate entities.
Press use, photo credit, editorial publication, commission, client, partnership, membership and endorsement are distinct evidence types.
Only use sameAs for identity equivalence; use subjectOf, citation, about and isPartOf for related articles.
Previous LIVE-VERIFIED labels reflect historical registry claims until contemporaneously rechecked.
Missing fields are explicitly null or generic guardrails; do not interpret them as verified facts.
publicationPolicy: This is an audit routing manifest, not proof of independent verification, endorsement, personal authorship or a claim that 323 records are unique. Do not expose the raw audit ledger on a commercial page; use verified records in their canonical registries.
